reviewer_statement: Provisional author-reviewed scientific source-contract record; direct seeded frozen Python 1.2 recovery runner comparison for ordinary mapping metrics, structured semantic metrics, retained fit failures and true simulation/scenario inputs committed. Exact-head workflow and independent scientific certification are pending.
native_language_semantic_policy: Native R S3 records are source-ordered scientific analogues of Python immutable dataclasses, not Python runtime identity; non-serializable arbitrary Python callback protocols, Python exception class inheritance and unseeded NumPy entropy realizations are not claimed. R-only source draw/schedule replay and enriched provenance remain outside source mode.

case_evidence.description: Frozen eyetrajectoriespy==1.2.0 simulate.py::run_functional_recovery_scenarios consumes a nonempty ordered list of FunctionalSimulationScenario analogue, required mean and eigenfunction callables, a truth-blinded estimator, a truth-aware recovery callback and explicit raise/record failure handling. Strict native python_boundary_mode TRUE invokes the seeded NumPy PCG64 source simulation, rejects R-only replay and emits canonical source-scientific returned structures.

Real seeded Gaussian functional simulation with a 3-participant by 2-trial design, five-point quadrature-orthonormal truth grid, two replicates seeded at 73/74; scalar finite recovered metrics, structured native FunctionalRecoveryAssessment metric definitions with zero-based components and provenance, deterministic fitting failures and both raise/record policies. The same scenarios and callbacks execute independently through frozen Python 1.2.

One exact simulation per declared replicate without replacement, seeded source-equivalent NumPy score/noise paths; estimator sees only observations and the design, recovery alone sees generating truth. Source scalar recovery metric values, structured hierarchy truth-source variance metrics, retained seed/replicate labels and error status records compared numerically and structurally against direct frozen Python 1.2 source results.

Nonempty typed scenario collection, estimator/recovery callables and failure_action policy enforced. Source mode rejects base-R RNG, fixed source scores/noise replay and manual irregular schedule replay. Simulation, fit and recovery exceptions are distinguished without redrawing, recorded with type/message or raised; invalid recovered metrics and inconsistent definitions remain fatal as in Python. A simple R stop() maps to Python RuntimeError only for matched validation fixtures; arbitrary Python exception classes are not claimed.

Exactly two fields of Python FunctionalRecoveryResult in strict mode (records,metric_definitions). Each ordered record has precisely nine source fields: scenario_name,replicate,seed,metrics,metric_values,status,error_type,error_message,assessment_provenance. Metric definitions are un-named ordered source-scientific records. All R-only provenance flags remain in default mode, not in Python boundary mode.

Known-truth Monte Carlo functional recovery evaluation: no truth leakage to estimator, no dropped failed replications, no automatic estimator selection, no silent redraws and no claim that a success score is a certified confidence-coverage result; recorded successes and failures describe behavior under explicitly declared synthetic generating scenarios.

independent_review_status: Author-reviewed provisional scientific source closure. No independent certification and no exact-head CI green claim.
language_specific_limits: Python frozen FunctionalSimulationScenario, FunctionalRecoveryRecord, FunctionalRecoveryValue and FunctionalRecoveryResult classes are native R scientific records and S3 analogous classes, not Python object identities.
The only translated exception mapping is a matching deliberate simple R stop() into Python RuntimeError; arbitrary Python exception subclasses, invalid inputs and callables are not identical.

R accepts declared finite scalar numeric-like callback mappings and native structured assessment records; Python general Mapping protocols and user-defined __float__ or __iter__ are not R object domains.
NumPy PCG64 seeded streams match in the supported exactly-representable R seed domain, not arbitrary SeedSequence/128-bit integers or fresh OS-entropy draws.
Source-mode R only supports source-generated schedules and score/noise draws rather than the native R fixed replay interfaces.
